_comment: Retrieval-quality baselines for eval/gates.py. Shrink-only for quality metrics (actual >= value - tolerance); raise-only for latency (actual <= value * (1 + tolerance)). A metric absent here is not gated. Raising a baseline is an explicit PR edit; lowering one requires justification in the PR body. See docs/EVALS.md.
_source: Direct-Qdrant offline retriever (no rerank/hybrid), 10-query smoke subset (scripts/run-eval-smoke.sh), 2026-09-18. Full 41-query set scored recall@10=0.317 / MRR=0.225. Provisional: the live engine path (Redis+FAISS) is expected to score higher; re-baseline once the nightly live job is green.
